// Root copies this one-off generator into an isolated staging tree at tests/local/.
// It is never run by CI and never creates publication or learner approval evidence.
import { readFile, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
import path from 'node:path';
import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { compileCourse } from '../../scripts/content/compileCourse';
import { PublicProvenanceManifestSchema } from '../../scripts/content/sourceSchema';
import { hashBytes, hashValue } from '../../scripts/release/v2/identity';
import { MovementInputsSchema } from '../../scripts/release/v2/movement';
import { javascriptLearnerContentSha256 } from '../../scripts/release/javascriptLessonEvaluation';
import { GlossaryEntrySchema, LessonSchema } from '../../src/core/content/schema';

const FIXED = [
  { lessonId: 'react-ch01-l01', profile: 'props-card-v1', goal: undefined, fixtures: 5 },
  { lessonId: 'react-ch03-l01', profile: 'quiz-workshop-v1', goal: 'quiz-card', fixtures: 8 },
  { lessonId: 'react-ch03-l02', profile: 'quiz-workshop-v1', goal: 'quiz-state', fixtures: 9 },
  { lessonId: 'react-ch04-l01', profile: 'quiz-capstone-v1', goal: 'quiz-capstone', fixtures: 8 },
] as const;
const ManifestSchema = z.object({
  sourceCommit: z.literal('21dcc855413a56729206b02c5a03701207123699'),
  files: z.array(z.object({ path: z.string(), bytes: z.number(), sha256: z.string() }).strict()),
}).strict();
const [output, manifestFile] = process.argv.slice(2);
if (!output || !manifestFile || !path.isAbsolute(output))
  throw Error('Usage: generator.ts ABSOLUTE_OUTPUT_JSON SOURCE_MANIFEST_JSON');
const manifest = ManifestSchema.parse(JSON.parse(await readFile(manifestFile, 'utf8')) as unknown);
for (const expected of manifest.files) {
  const bytes = await readFile(expected.path);
  if (bytes.length !== expected.bytes || hashBytes(bytes) !== expected.sha256)
    throw Error('Protected source differs: ' + expected.path);
}
const compilation = await compileCourse(path.resolve('content/react'));
const allLessons = compilation.runtime.phases.flatMap((phase) => phase.chapters)
  .flatMap((chapter) => chapter.lessons);
const lessons = FIXED.map((fixed) => {
  const lesson = allLessons.find((row) => row.id === fixed.lessonId);
  if (!lesson || lesson.exercises.length !== 1 || lesson.exercises[0]?.id !== fixed.lessonId + '-e01')
    throw Error('Missing fixed original React goal: ' + fixed.lessonId);
  return LessonSchema.parse(lesson);
});
const originals = MovementInputsSchema.shape.current.parse([{ courseId: 'react',
  exercises: FIXED.map((fixed) => {
    const full = compilation.authoringExercises?.find((row) => row.id === fixed.lessonId + '-e01');
    if (!full || full.runtime?.kind !== 'react' || full.runtime.profile !== fixed.profile ||
      full.runtime.learningGoal !== fixed.goal || full.fixtures.length !== fixed.fixtures)
      throw Error('Non-original React goal/profile/fixture count: ' + fixed.lessonId);
    return full;
  }),
}])[0];
if (!originals || originals.exercises.length !== 4) throw Error('Expected exactly four authored goals');
const glossaryRefs = new Set(lessons.flatMap((lesson) => lesson.glossaryRefs));
const glossary = z.array(GlossaryEntrySchema).parse(compilation.runtime.glossary
  .filter((entry) => glossaryRefs.has(entry.id)));
if (glossary.length !== glossaryRefs.size) throw Error('Fixed glossary coverage differs');
const assetRefs = lessons.flatMap((lesson) => [
  ...lesson.slides.flatMap((slide) => slide.assets),
  ...lesson.exercises.flatMap((exercise) => exercise.assets),
]);
const assetKeys = [...new Set(assetRefs.map((asset) => asset.path.replace(/^generated\/content\//u, '')))];
if (assetKeys.length !== 4) throw Error('Expected exactly four original visible assets');
const assets = assetKeys.map((key) => {
  const bytes = compilation.assets.get(key);
  if (!bytes) throw Error('Missing original asset bytes: ' + key);
  return { key, sha256: hashBytes(bytes), base64: Buffer.from(bytes).toString('base64') };
});
const provenanceIds = new Set(assetRefs.map((asset) => asset.provenanceId));
const publicProvenance = PublicProvenanceManifestSchema.parse({ ...compilation.publicProvenance,
  items: compilation.publicProvenance.items.filter((item) => provenanceIds.has(item.id)),
});
if (publicProvenance.items.length !== provenanceIds.size) throw Error('Fixed asset provenance differs');
const data = { lessons, authoringExercises: originals.exercises, glossary, publicProvenance, assets };
const value = {
  schemaVersion: 1,
  purpose: 'synthetic-unit-protocol-not-publication-approval',
  provenance: {
    sourceCommit: manifest.sourceCommit,
    generatorSha256: hashBytes(await readFile(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url))),
    sourceManifestDigest: hashValue(manifest),
    sourceFiles: manifest.files,
    fixedGoalIds: FIXED.map((row) => row.lessonId),
    authoredFixtureCounts: FIXED.map((row) => row.fixtures),
    authoredFixtureCount: originals.exercises.reduce((sum, exercise) => sum + exercise.fixtures.length, 0),
    movedFixtureCount: 25,
    assetCount: assets.length,
    learnerDigests: lessons.map((lesson) => ({ lessonId: lesson.id,
      sha256: javascriptLearnerContentSha256(lesson, compilation.runtime.glossary, compilation.assets) })),
    dataDigest: hashValue(data),
  },
  data,
};
await writeFile(output, JSON.stringify(value, null, 2) + '\n', { flag: 'wx', mode: 0o600 });
process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({ output, goals: lessons.length, authoredFixtures: value.provenance.authoredFixtureCount,
  movedFixtures: 25, assets: assets.length, outputBytes: Buffer.byteLength(JSON.stringify(value, null, 2) + '\n'),
  dataDigest: value.provenance.dataDigest }) + '\n');
